## [▶ Open the slides](slides/index.html)

From no Python at all to trained, evaluated models in two hours, on 11/11/2026.
Nothing to install — everything runs in Google Colab.

By **Dr. Rachid Zeghlache**, Assistant Professor of computer science (Artificial Intelligence), American University in Dubai. The fast cut of the four-hour workshop: the same
four steps (Python → explore → first models → compare & challenge), the same
animations, and interactive widgets you can drag and slide.
